name: Exclusive Choice
description: Routes each record to exactly one of several mutually exclusive downstream paths based on a discriminating predicate. Guarantees that a single input maps to a single output channel — never duplicated.
when_to_use: Records must be processed by exactly one downstream handler
Mutually exclusive business categories partition the dataset
Routing logic must be deterministic and complete
benefits: Easy to test each path in isolation
drawbacks: Adding a new path needs router update
use_cases: Order type dispatcher (digital vs physical vs subscription)
Event classifier routing to topic-specific pipelines
